payload.title: File:Allgoviachen.jpg
payload.artist_html: Gerald Mayr, Thomas Lechner, Madelaine Böhme
payload.description_html: Partial leg of Allgoviachen tortonica, from the earliest late Miocene (Tortonian) of the Hammerschmiede clay pit (holotype, SNSB-BSPG 2020 XCIV 1058). (a) ‒ (d) Left tibiotarsus in (a) cranial, (b) medial, (c) caudal, and (d) lateral view, with details of the distal end in (e) cranial and (f) distal view. (g)‒ (j) Left tarsometatarsus in (g) dorsal, (h) medial, (i) plantar, and (j) lateral view. (k) Pedal phalanges. Abbreviations: brg, breakage; ccc, crista cnemialis cranialis; cdl, condylus lateralis; cdm, condylus medialis; crf, crista fibularis; fib, fibula; ito, intratendinous ossification; pst, pons supratendineus. Scale bars equal 10 mm. [Description modified from Mayr et al.]
